_comment: A team's LAST unit routs, without instantly losing. Stages team 0's ONLY unit -- a full-strength (120) but shaken (morale 10) player infantry -- meeting a single, slightly larger enemy infantry (130) head-on. Both blocks are pinned to Tight (formation 1) so packed files still produce the rout inside this clip -- default Normal 2x thins contact enough that onset misses the budget. Sustained frontal casualties and being outnumbered (the local force ratio, 120 to 130) erode its morale to 0 (the discipline-scaled rout retune, #529, made this actually reachable -- it used to sit near-immune to routing and simply grind to a stalemate), and it breaks and flees up (faded) while barely bloodied. It used to trigger instant defeat + a paused freeze the moment its last fightable unit left the line; now the battle stays live while it's routing. Routing units are still valid combat targets, and the enemy follows it as it flees -- state-dump verified on its own seed: FIGHTING at tick 950, ROUTING from tick 976 at (786.0, 506.9) with 108 of its 120 men, and still ROUTING at tick 1300, the clip's end, its anchor at (787.65, 197.42), 309.5 wu from where it broke, with its pursuer (uid 1) MOVING after it 178.5 wu behind (measured 2026-11-07 on 580995c5). Its first flight turn snaps, so its grid keeps its front toward the pursuer, 146 degrees off its heading on this seed, and it is anchored on the men ahead along its flight: on this seed its anchor moves from x 786.0 at the break (tick 976) to 790.4 at its last tick in contact (1095). The position pin at tick 1300 was re-pinned for #1825 from (748.7, 224.0), measured on 580995c5, with Ezra's approval of 2026-11-06: that pin recorded the bug, in which the anchor sat on the grid's front ranks, which trailed the flight and stayed in contact. On main 1d0d7705 the anchor slides 28.3 wu west while in contact (x 786.0 at tick 976 to 757.7 at tick 1103) and has gone 36.9 wu west by tick 1300 (749.07, 223.78). The tol of 5 wu is unchanged. STAGING (#1827): blocks front to front now meet at their front ranks, so only the front ranks trade blows, and against an equal 120 it no longer broke reliably inside the clip: at morale 6 it did not break at all on its own seed. On perturbed seeds 1 to 4 this staging breaks at ticks 980 to 1270 and is still ROUTING at tick 1300 on each. This clip only needs to show the rout starting and the battle staying live through it, not the whole grind. No player input needed.

shape_residual.reason: The pursuer (uid 1) chases the router with its grid still scrambled from the fight: its slot residual reads 12 to 16 wu while in contact (not judged) and 19 to 21 wu once contact breaks, against 6.75. Measured 2026-11-10 on aef5b476, seeds 0 to 4. On dense 2-tick FULL dumps over ticks 2 to 1400, every exemption removed, the verdict FAILS on seeds 0, 1, 3 and 4 (worst 22.9, 27.2, 38 and 24.2) and passes on seed 2 (0.00171). On the clip's own declared ticks (950, 1000, 1300) it passes on every seed (worst 0), so there the exemption reads STALE. Kept because it fires on four of five seeds on dense dumps. The same deformation in pursuit reads 25.2 on merge-base a3714751's own staging (2-tick samples), where it does not last long enough to fail the check; this staging breaks earlier (#1827). #1824 tracks a pursuer deforming at the edge of a router's contact range.
